resources.string: TV connection restored. No correction settings were changed.
Open Phone companion on your TV, then reconnect. The saved pairing is kept.
Not connected · the values below are last known, not live. Reconnect before changing the TV.
Same network. One scan. No account.
Connect to your TV to choose a listening mode, change profiles, and switch correction. Pair once; your phone remembers the TV.
A mode changes the tone over your room correction, not the room measurement.
1. Choose the TV output and a comfortable volume.\n2. Put the phone at your listening position.\n3. Keep still and quiet while the TV plays a sweep.
Connect to your TV in the TV tab before starting a measurement.
Keep this screen open. Leave the phone still and the TV volume unchanged.
The first sweep is still on the TV. Save it before starting another measurement.
The screen stays awake during capture. Leaving the app cancels recording. A saved measurement becomes the selected TV profile; correction stays on or off as you chose.
The phone link is available only while Phone companion is open on the TV. Leaving that TV screen disconnects the phone; it does not switch correction off.
On your TV, open Core EQ → Phone companion → Start pairing. Keep that screen open and scan its QR code here. Both devices need to be on the same local network.
Revoke this phone on the TV and remove the saved connection. Correction and profiles on the TV will not be turned off or deleted.
This phone remembers one TV. Pairing replaces its saved connection, but does not revoke the previous TV pairing or change that TV\'s correction.
Stop this recording and the TV sweep? If the first sweep has already reached the TV, Core EQ will try to save it on its own.
The TV accepted the command, but its new status could not be read. It was not retried. Reconnect to check the result before making another change.
Could not confirm the TV update: %1$s. It was not retried automatically. Reconnect to check the result.
QR scanner ready. Tap Scan TV QR when you return to pairing.
